title: Where do Europeans feel most affected by personal data misuse?
subtitle: In 2026, 47% of EU respondents named the misuse of personal data as one of the online issues that affect them most, up from 46% in 2024.
textNote: Special Eurobarometer 572 interviewed 26,494 people aged 15 and over across the EU from 5 February to 1 March 2026. Respondents could select up to three online platform issues they felt had the greatest personal impact.
